d:
Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following a scandal involving an admitted affair and allegations of a Chinese intelligence operation. US intelligence officials believe the woman at the centre of the story, Chinese executive Alice Huang (Huang Le), may have worked with China’s Ministry of State Security.
In this first episode of China Watch, Aadil Brar examines the allegations, traces Alice Huang’s business connections across China and Southeast Asia, and investigates how the story unfolded on Chinese social media.
